svg.font-family: Amazon Ember, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Supplier Gateway architecture on AWS ECS Fargate
svg.title: Supplier Gateway — ECS Fargate on AWS
svg.desc: An ALB in the public subnets routes to four Fargate services in the private subnets, which communicate through AmazonMQ RabbitMQ and persist to RDS PostgreSQL. VPC endpoints keep ECR, CloudWatch Logs, Secrets Manager and S3 traffic off the NAT gateway.
svg.text: AWS traffic that bypasses the NAT

g.text: one log group per service · 14 days

svg.text: Deployed as six CloudFormation stacks: setup-buckets, setup-environment, setup-database, setup-amazonmq, setup-secrets, setup-cluster-ecs
